title: 信息日报 2026-08-24

headline.title: Ora 在 Vercel 上为各大主流 AI 代理做基准测试
headline.summary: Vercel博客详解其AI代理平台Ora如何在真实网站上对主流AI代理进行同台测试。Ora的16人工程团队每天提交数百次代码，在活体网站上派出代理执行注册、集成、付费等任务。结果表明，目前99%的网站不适合代理操作。文章同时展示了前端、后端和代理运行时统一在一体化平台上的实践。
headline.title_en: How Ora benchmarks every major AI agent on Vercel
headline.summary_en: Vercel's blog explains how Ora benchmarks every major AI agent on live websites, instructing agents to sign up for products, integrate, and pay. With a 16-person engineering team producing hundreds of commits a day, Ora runs agents side-by-side on real sites and often sees them fail. By Ora's estimate, 99% of the web isn't agent-ready. The piece also highlights the benefits of having front-end, back-end, and agent runtime on one platform. This real-world testing offers practical insight into AI agent reliability.
headline.original_title: How Ora benchmarks every major AI agent on Vercel
headline.reason: 作为头条，因为它反映了当前AI代理从演示走向真实场景的关键评测，对开发者和AI行业具有直接参考价值；同时Vercel作为基础设施提供商的视角，揭示了代理落地的真实瓶颈。
headline.reason_en: As the lead, this story captures the shift of AI agents from demos to real-world evaluation, offering direct insights for developers and the AI industry. Vercel's infrastructure perspective also exposes the real bottleneck: most of the web isn't ready for agents.
